failure_modes.cause: Discovery and preparation use the same Phase 1 guard
failure_modes.effect: Incomplete documents or unapproved external action
failure_modes.detection: Phase 1 regressions and discovery-only stage/API negative cases
failure_modes.mitigation: Separate discovery capability; keep all existing live submission containment and NZ writing gates

failure_modes.cause: Whole YAML serialization/inheritance or empty allowlist fallback
failure_modes.mitigation: Lossless scoped campaign updates, dedicated defaults and explicit empty source sets

failure_modes.mode: Restricted/unvalidated source is fetched or sent to AI
failure_modes.cause: Metadata silently discarded, forged validation, redirect or direct helper bypass
failure_modes.mitigation: Validated permission modes, source fingerprints, server-owned validation and per-request host/public-address checks; manual reference-only fallback

failure_modes.mode: Distinct jobs collapse or signed application links break
failure_modes.cause: Legacy query stripping or fuzzy dedupe
failure_modes.detection: Identity-query, provider ID, signed URL and cross-country duplicate fixtures
failure_modes.mitigation: NZ-specific conservative identities/original URLs; no historical rekeys/adoption or status resets

failure_modes.cause: Implicit NZD/annual hours, hybrid treated remote or reachable treated open
failure_modes.mitigation: Raw plus structured provenance, separate timestamps, conservative same-basis salary filtering and explicit unknown states

failure_modes.mode: Tests or validation touch real user data/services
failure_modes.cause: Inherited paths/credentials or source enum mistaken for permission
failure_modes.effect: Sensitive changes or unauthorised live requests
failure_modes.detection: Isolated env, mocked/read-only local source tests and zero-network denial cases
failure_modes.mitigation: No production startup/migrations, no source activated without actual entitlement, existing local dependencies only
